did.description: The DID of the account to register.

accountType.description: The role to assign the new account. Defaults to `standard`; assigning a non-standard role requires administrative standing (only a rootAdmin may assign rootAdmin).

acl.description: Initial access-control capabilities. Members omitted take the mediator's configured defaults.

queueLimits.description: Initial queued-message limits. Members omitted take the mediator's configured defaults.

Response.title: Messaging Add Account — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/account/add request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/account/add/0.1#response.

account.description: The full realized mediator view of the newly created account.
